qualification: Declared once, not tuned on any result or ground truth. Sensor noise and process densities come from --noise-config (default configs/example_uncalibrated.json, which declares itself UNCALIBRATED illustrative values).
same_surface_note: Bilinear 2x2 support is one surface when max-min neighbour depth <= n_sigma*sqrt(2)*sigma_D(z) + z*tan(max_incidence)*sqrt(2)/min(fx,fy); otherwise DEPTH_DISCONTINUITY (no sample, no gradient across a depth break).
visibility_note: Self-occlusion: a point is behind the front-most projected point of its pixel when z_i - z_front > n_sigma*sqrt(sigma_zi^2 + sigma_zfront^2), sigma_z from the PRIOR position covariance. External occlusion: measured depth in front of the predicted point by more than n_sigma*sqrt(S_zz), S_zz = H_D P- H_D^T + R_D the predicted depth-innovation variance (chi-square gating of the one occlusion-explicable sign; the other sign is the motion signal and is kept).
row_innovation_gate_note: Per-row admission on the innovation linearized back to the prior, nu = r + H_x (x_j - x-), S = H_x P-_xx H_x^T + R (estimator/projective_terms.py). 'rgbd_chi2': nu_D > n_sigma sqrt(S_DD) -> MEASURED_SURFACE_IN_FRONT, else nu^T S^-1 nu > chi2_4(1 - alpha_row) -> INNOVATION_INCONSISTENT, alpha_row = 2(1 - Phi(visibility_n_sigma)). 'depth_two_sided': only |nu_D| > n_sigma sqrt(S_DD). 'depth_front_only': the earlier one-sided rule (negative depth innovations of any size admitted as motion). Audit 2026-10-28 items 4, 5, 11.
update_acceptance_note: Per-point acceptance of the IEKF result (estimator/point_kalman_cuda.py): posterior cost J = |s - s-|^2_{P-^-1} + r^T R^-1 r at the actual samples of the iterate, consistent when J <= chi2_{4m}(1 - alpha_row); accepted state = final iterate if consistent, else the last consistent iterate (j >= 1), else prediction only. 'final_iterate' = the earlier rule (final iterate accepted whenever it has a valid row, converged or not). Audit 2026-10-28 items 1, 2, 3.
final_visibility_note: Acceptance linearization: the per-frame frozen pixel assignment plus a fresh SELF_OCCLUDED check at the current states, so an accepted state never uses a pixel whose front-most point is another point in front of it. 'frozen' = the earlier rule. Audit 2026-10-28 item 6.
interpolation_variance_note: Bilinear interpolation of independent pixel noise: var = sum_j w_j^2 sigma_j^2 (contract 2.1).
model_variance_note: Additive appearance/geometry model-mismatch variances (fixed canonical colour vs view-dependent appearance). 0 = not modelled; an assumption, stated, not hidden.
iekf_step_note: Per-point convergence when delta^T A delta < tolerance (squared step in the posterior-information metric, dimensionless).
support_alpha_source: configs/image_joint_policy.json tail_probability (one declared alpha for the joint adequacy tests and the support FDR)
